paper: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
headline_mechanism: TradingAgents sends market, social, news, and fundamental reports through bull/bear research debate, trader synthesis, three risk-perspective debates, a final manager, and reflection memory.

source_anchors.claim: Four specialized analysts independently examine market, social, news, and fundamental information.
Bullish and bearish researchers debate the analyst reports before a trader synthesizes a proposal.
Risk-seeking, neutral, and conservative perspectives debate the trader proposal before the fund manager decides.
Outcome reflection updates memory so future decisions can learn from earlier successes and mistakes.

preserved_elements: explicit bull and bear evidence aggregation
risk-seeking, neutral, and conservative proposal variants
rolling reflection memory from earlier realized outcomes
approximated_elements: JKP market, attention, earnings, and fundamental bundles replace external analyst tools and text reports
positive and negative decompositions of analyst scores replace natural-language bull/bear debate
past RankIC reliability replaces the trader's LLM synthesis
volatility scaling replaces the three natural-language risk debaters
rolling correctness-weight updates replace episodic reflection text
invented_elements: the exact JKP analyst feature bundles
risk-seeking, neutral, and conservative volatility multipliers
common value-weighted long/short decile portfolio adapter
portfolio_adapter: The final manager confidence is ranked within the frozen monthly top-1,000 universe and mapped to common value-weighted long/short deciles with 10 bp one-way cost; no unavailable native execution state is invented.
claim_boundary: This is a researcher-authored TradingAgents-inspired numerical debate graph, not the paper-time LLM agents, tool reports, prompts, actions, portfolio engine, or native results.
